name: sgs/social-icons
title: SGS Social Icons
description: A row of SGS Icon blocks linked to Site Info: phone, email, address and every social network, each hidden while its Site Info field is empty. Sets the icons' size, shape, background, border and colours once for the whole row; any icon can still set its own.

siteInfoLinkRow._note: Cloning lifts each draft link into an allowedBlocks child bound through this source and attribute when the brand registry knows its platform.

wrapper.label: Row
wrapper._note: The row (`.sgs-social-icons`, role list): a wrapping flex row of sgs/icon children. Gap per device, alignment along the row, Spacing padding and margin.

shape.label: Icon shapes
shape._note: Group defaults for every child's `.sgs-icon__shape`, printed on the row as --sgs-si-* custom properties that icon/style.css reads after the icon's own value; a child that sets its own value wins.

glyph.label: Icon glyphs
glyph._note: Group default glyph size (--sgs-si-size) for every child's `.sgs-icon__svg`.

label.label: Icon labels
label._note: Group defaults for every child's `.sgs-icon__label-text`: colours as --sgs-si-label-colour[-hover] (a gradient as a scoped rule that skips an icon with a label colour of its own), typography as one scoped rule an icon's own label typography out-ranks. childIconShowLabel and childIconLabelPosition reach the children through block context.

ariaLabel.description: The row's accessible name (it is a list). Blank: "Social media and contact".

hiddenLinks.description: Site Info keys whose icon is kept in the row but not shown (the Links checklist's unticked rows).

colourMode.description: Colours for icons left on Automatic: inherit gives a brand icon its brand colours, theme never does, brand always does. An icon's own choice and any colour set here or on the icon win.

childIconSize.description: Glyph size per device {desktop,tablet,mobile} for every icon: a CSS length (px, rem, em, %) or a theme spacing preset.

childIconShape.description: Shape for every icon left on the square. '' leaves each icon's own shape.

childIconShowBackground.description: Paints a background behind every icon.

childIconShapeSize.description: Shape size per device {desktop:{width,height},…} for every icon. Circle uses width only; height follows width while childIconShapeSizeLinked.

childIconColourGradient.description: Gradient painting every outline glyph (wins over childIconColour); an icon with its own colour or a filled brand mark keeps its own paint.

childIconBackgroundGradient.description: Gradient painting every icon's background (wins over childIconBackground); an icon with its own background keeps it.

childIconBorderWidth.description: Border width {top,right,bottom,left} for every icon's shape. An icon's own border wins.

childIconBorderStyle.description: Group default: '' paints solid when a width is set.

childIconShowLabel.description: Shows every icon's visible label (an icon can also switch on its own).

childIconLabelPosition.description: Label position for every icon left on end. '' leaves each icon's own.

childIconLabelColourGradient.description: Gradient painting every label (wins over childIconLabelColour); an icon with its own label colour keeps it.

gap.description: Space between icons per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}: a CSS length or a theme spacing preset. Unset = spacing-20.
